info.title: GovCon IGCE, Wrap-Rate & Price-to-Win Modeler API
info.description: Transforms RFP Section B CLIN structures, PWS/SOW level-of-effort & LCAT staffing requirements, and historical award benchmarks into an Independent Government Cost Estimate (IGCE), compounded Indirect Wrap-Rate breakdown (Fringe / Overhead / G&A / Fee), GSA CALC+ LCAT rate card, Multi-Year CLIN pricing schedule, 4-scenario Price-to-Win (PTW) sensitivity matrix, and Shipley Volume IV Basis of Estimate (BOE) narrative.

post.summary: Generate GovCon IGCE, Wrap-Rate & Price-to-Win Model
post.operationId: Generate GovCon IGCE, Wrap-Rate & Price-to-Win Model
post.description: Builds an Independent Government Cost Estimate (IGCE), compounded Indirect Wrap-Rate breakdown, GSA CALC+ aligned LCAT rate card, Section B CLIN schedule, and 4-tier Price-to-Win (PTW) model.

example.rfp_section_b_and_sow_text: SOLICITATION W52P1J-26-R-0088 (U.S. Army Enterprise Cloud & DevSecOps Engineering): Section B CLIN Structure: Base Year (12 Months) + Four (4) 12-Month Option Years (5-Year Total PoP). CLIN 0001 (FFP): Core Cloud Platform & Zero-Trust DevSecOps Engineering (18 FTEs total: 1 Program Manager [TS/SCI, 1,920 hrs/yr], 3 Principal Cloud Architects [TS/SCI, 1,920 hrs/yr], 8 Senior DevSecOps / Kubernetes Engineers [Secret, 1,920 hrs/yr], 4 Cybersecurity ISSO / RMF Analysts [Secret, 1,920 hrs/yr], 2 Cloud FinOps & Automation Specialists [Secret, 1,920 hrs/yr]). CLIN 0002 (Cost-Reimbursable No-Fee): Other Direct Costs (ODCs) & Travel ceiling fixed at $185,000/year. Place of Performance: Contractor-site (80% remote/NCR Washington DC metro locality) + 20% Fort Belvoir, VA.
example.historical_benchmark_and_incumbent_conte: Incumbent task order was awarded in 2021 at $24.8M over 5 years ($4.96M/yr) for 16 FTEs under GSA MAS SIN 54151S. Current GSA CALC+ NCR medians for cleared DevSecOps/Cloud roles range from $148/hr to $215/hr burdened.
example.bidder_indirect_wrap_assumptions: Contractor-site indirect rates: Fringe 29.5%, Overhead 18.0%, G&A 11.5%, Target FFP Profit/Fee 9.0%. Productive year = 1,920 billable hours/FTE. Annual Option Year labor escalation = 3.0%/year.

WrapRateBreakdown.description: Compounded indirect wrap-rate breakdown (Fringe -> Overhead -> G&A -> Fee).

fringe_rate_pct.description: Fringe benefits percentage applied to direct labor (e.g., 29.5%).
fringe_rate_pct.title: Fringe Rate Pct

overhead_rate_pct.description: Overhead percentage (Contractor-site or Government-site) applied to Direct Labor + Fringe.
overhead_rate_pct.title: Overhead Rate Pct

general_and_administrative_ga_pct.description: General & Administrative (G&A) percentage applied to total cost input.
general_and_administrative_ga_pct.title: General And Administrative Ga Pct

target_fee_or_profit_pct.description: Target profit/fee percentage (e.g., 7.0%–10.0% FFP/T&M or 5.0%–8.0% CPFF).
target_fee_or_profit_pct.title: Target Fee Or Profit Pct

compounded_wrap_multiplier_without_fee.description: Compounded cost wrap multiplier before fee: (1 + Fringe) * (1 + OH) * (1 + G&A).
compounded_wrap_multiplier_without_fee.title: Compounded Wrap Multiplier Without Fee

fully_burdened_wrap_multiplier_with_fee.description: Total fully burdened wrap multiplier including fee: cost_wrap * (1 + Fee).
fully_burdened_wrap_multiplier_with_fee.title: Fully Burdened Wrap Multiplier With Fee

annual_productive_hours_per_fte.description: Annual productive billable hours per FTE (typically 1,880 or 1,920 hours after PTO/holidays).
annual_productive_hours_per_fte.title: Annual Productive Hours Per Fte

annual_option_year_escalation_pct.description: Annual labor escalation percentage applied across Option Years (e.g., 3.0%).
annual_option_year_escalation_pct.title: Annual Option Year Escalation Pct

wrap_structure_justification.description: Audit-ready explanation of how the indirect wrap multiplier was compounded and benchmarked.
wrap_structure_justification.title: Wrap Structure Justification

WrapRateBreakdown.title: WrapRateBreakdown
